start: History, a saved workout 'Push 1' with Bench Press (warm-up, 3 sets), weighted dips and a workout note; phone in kilograms

steps.action: Open the workout, open its menu and tap 'Share as text'
user_sees: The phone's share menu with the text
must_not: Nothing happens
A picture instead of text

steps.action: Pick ChatGPT (or any app) and read the text
user_sees: First line 'Here is my workout from MettleUp. Please review it and suggest what to change next time.'
A totals line like '18 working sets · 4,250 kg lifted (body weight not counted)'
must_not: The member's body weight, name or phone number
A kg-lifted total that includes body weight
A record in kilos on a body-weight move

start: History, the month view of October 2026 (and the year 2026 so far)

user_sees: Text starting 'Here is my training for October 2026 from MettleUp. Please review it and suggest what to change next month.'
'Kg lifted: … kg (body weight not counted)' when a body-weight move is in it
must_not: Sets from September or November counted
Body weight in the kg lifted

steps.action: Share the year while it is still running
user_sees: '… suggest what to change from here.'
must_not: The year shown as complete

start: Settings → Your data → 'Ask an AI about your workouts'

user_sees: 'The text you will share' with the text shown before sharing
must_not: The text sent before the member taps the button

steps.action: Tap 'Share to an AI app' and pick an app
must_not: MettleUp sending the text anywhere itself

start: Share as text with nothing to share

user_sees: 'Log a workout, then come back here to ask an AI about it.'
must_not: An empty share
A share button that sends a blank text

steps.action: Share a month with no workouts
must_not: 'Kg lifted: 0 kg' or 'NaN'

steps.action: Tap 'Share to an AI app' when the share menu fails to open
must_not: A crash

start: A workout already shared as text once

steps.action: Edit the workout (add a set), then share as text again

must_not: The old text shared again

must_not: A record from a deleted workout

A total that divides back to body weight (kg lifted ÷ reps)
Photos, measurements, name or phone number
